en: Revenge on the Mirage - consultation text
note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: Search every corner of the northern Blanc Desert and you'll meet a strange beast. Actually, I met it once myself while spreading the teachings. What did I do when I met it? ...Well, I'll tell you sometime.
At the Heerdahl Martial Arts Tourney, you can even fight Professor Rombino! Will something good happen if you win?

note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: This one's all about strength. Strength! Rombino can take it, so go all out!!
On the top floor of Heerdahl, Mistress challenged you to a game played with coins, a glass and water.

note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: It's a pure battle of wits. No cheating at all. So do your best. ...And don't be swayed by any strange temptations, all right? By the way, they say this game has a sure-fire way to win...
Analis the Skunk Girl is having trouble finding work. Getting back the bell stolen from the priest of Madrie Church would apparently land Analis a job, but...
Skunk Girl's Job Hunt - consultation text
note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: Follow Analis's lead, then search the nearby walls at the end and you should find a hidden door. The thief is inside, so do your best to get the bell back.
Lost in a blizzard, you were rescued by a strange woman. Who on earth is she...?
Icy Night Counting Snow - consultation text
note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: Hmm. Perhaps that was a spirit called a "Snow Woman," from the legends of the land far to the east. If she's on your mind, why not visit her now and then?
note: editorial: [JP] = 'the land far to the east' as in 54:6.

en: You accepted Miyuki's feelings, but then Miyuki was carried off by someone from Glacier Castle...
Your Hand at First Frost - consultation text
note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: If your feelings are mutual, let's go save her! But I hear this General Winter is awfully stubborn. So show him something like his wife's portrait to soften him up. It should be hidden behind the castle.
You were asked to find the bungee gear needed for the Goblin Prince's coronation: a "bungee rope" and a "Handcrafted Zabutoon."

note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: This one's a real hassle. Well, if you keep going around talking to everyone, I think it'll sort itself out eventually, so be patient and keep at it.
The Pyroglyph Researcher in Baroque Fort asked you to help with the research.
note: editorial: one specific person; glossary title 'Pyroglyph Researcher', as in 82:8.
accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: Ancient script research, is it! Why not try answering [┌┐┘└├┬┤] for the first, [┴┏┓┛┣┗┳] for the second, [┫┻┠┯┨┷┿] for the third, and [┝┰┥┸╂] for the last!?
Once the coronation was over, you were asked to take Goblin Prince Montana to the royal tomb of the ogres and goblins in the Churos Highlands.
Report to the Ancestors - consultation text
note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: That would be 1F on the north side of the Churos Highlands. You can't go on without finding a hidden door, so search hard for it.
note: editorial: floor notation 1F as in the other hints and the script.

en: You finished enrolling at Rubenburg. Will you actually manage to graduate?

note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: The school sets lots of tough exams, so no slacking off, all right? Still, if you walk every corner of the school building, I think you'll pick up hints to the questions, so give it your best.
In the Magic Research Wing, you can even fight Professor Nambino! Will something good happen if you win?
note: editorial: identical Japanese sentence as 67:6, identical English.
accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: As befits a school that teaches spells, only spells work on Professor Nambino. It should be a good test of strength for Mages and other spellcasters.

note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: I'll lend you an Angel's Window. Then again, I don't have to lend it... What do you think, hmm?
According to Soara, the school's Board Chair is about to dabble in a forbidden arcane experiment. You were asked to help uncover the truth.
note: editorial: [JP] = 'the school' as in 75:8 and the script.

en: Stop the Forbidden Expt. - consultation text
note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: This calls for a head-on charge, plain and simple. Storm in through the Principal's Office and demand answers.
Radrecht, the Fire Sage, was wilting in the heat of the Scorching Castle. The spirits seem to be raising a ruckus underground...

note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: I've heard of the Spirit Tournament: the fire kin gather to vie for first place. Well, if they've lost their senses and are running riot, it's easiest to make them all promise to enter, then handle them all at once.
Radrecht, back in good spirits, entrusted you with a love letter addressed to Shirinmorin.

note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: What, Radrecht is sweet on Lady Shirinmorin!? Well, well, my word. So even the Four Sages fall in love. If you've been asked to deliver it, there's nothing for it but to deliver it.
note: accuracy: [JP] = 'Lady Shirinmorin' (convention, as in 39:8 / 47:7). [JP] stays plain 'Radrecht' (gender not settled by the script).

en: At the entrance to the Churos Highlands, an adventurer with a past entrusted you with returning the Great Tree Staff to the Unicorn, along with her thanks.
Regards to the Unicorn - consultation text
note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: To reach the Unicorn, you'll probably have to go with Innocents only -- that is, characters who have never changed class.
The Librarian led you to a land newly reborn: the New Land, Urnas Rade. What can you do for her?

note: accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).

en: You'll need the help of many people: Princess Leafa, King Montana, the Pyroglyph Researcher... Carve the true Earth Mother's name into Reiblair, then take the ogres' and goblins' Yuan Wine to the one so named.
note: editorial: 'bring that one' was unclear; [JP] = the one bearing that name.
accuracy: placeholder label aligned to the '<Title> - consultation/event/hint text' pattern of rslices 000-002 (lead).
